title: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY in one query
why_it_matters: These three words cover most of the reads you will ever write.
explanation: SELECT picks columns, FROM picks the table, WHERE keeps only matching rows, and ORDER BY sorts what is left. Read it top to bottom like a sentence and you can write most basic queries.
code:
select name, price
from products
where price < 5000
order by price;
try_it: Write the same query for a table of your own with a different WHERE.
